body: Stop request-local hover inference only when the selected binding has a fully settled concrete type; otherwise infer the complete body. Instead: Keep complete-body inference and investigate declaration loading costs further.

title: Should the automatic-worker latency experiment seed each private Cargo artifact directory from a disclosed owned warm cache before Cargo runs, while retaining the cold unavailable-declaration observation separately?
wrong_if: Relocated artifacts may be rejected or rebuilt by Cargo; stale or incompatible artifacts must never be presented as generated current APIs. Shared or hardlinked mutable artifacts could corrupt the seed and invalidate comparisons.

The existing prefetch uses four scoped readers, exact frozen transaction cells, dynamic assignment, no semantic-query concurrency and no permanent pool; five tests cover overlap, progress past a blocked artifact, cancellation, genuine errors and Arc release. Eight readers are a measured experiment, not a claim that p95 or idle acceptance will pass.
title: Should the existing temporary lookup-artifact prefetch use eight readers to reduce the measured first-hover artifact preparation delay?

Retain the old binary and reports, preserve bounded cancellation and transaction release, measure full-count query/filter series and final matched idle memory, and revert to four if there is no useful benefit. No long-lived cache or scheduler changes are authorized by this decision.

Poll only valid cancellation notifications inside the existing ingress envelope, preserve every Pending future unchanged, and prove exactly-once handling, real canceled errors and subsequent progress with actual LspService/Server barriers and genuine Devlist editor delivery.
